slides.headline: Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision
slides.say: Here's one worth knowing... Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision.

slides.headline: What it does
slides.body: Recognizes speech in many languages, translates to English, identifies language spoken
slides.say: It recognizes speech in many languages, translates to English, and identifies what language is being spoken.

slides.headline: 112,546 GitHub stars
slides.body: MIT licence · Written in Python · Since September 2022
slides.say: It has over 110 thousand stars on GitHub and uses the MIT licence.

slides.headline: Before you use it
